source_snapshot.procedure: Open BMC Web Inventory and LEDs and check Chassis information.
source_snapshot.script: None; 20 attended and 20 machine minutes; source requests log clearing.
source_snapshot.deepseek: YES listing only .Members[].Name from /redfish/v1/Chassis with TLS bypass and inline credentials.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION at MEDIUM risk; complete expected member/role matrix, all collection members and fields, same-target UI evidence and deterministic comparison.

historical_reviews.deepseek: Names-only enumeration cannot establish complete membership, roles, identity or per-chassis fields, and the unsafe query cannot support all-information acceptance.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Correctly changes the conclusion because Chassis is a collection whose membership and every member resource must be validated against a platform-specific contract.
historical_reviews.history: No earlier exact source identity record exists.
historical_reviews.v3_1: Collection completeness is a graph problem: member count, stable URIs, resource roles and links to the managed system must agree. Comparing display names alone can collapse distinct enclosure, board and virtual chassis resources.

original_test_intent: Validate the complete BMC Chassis inventory—expected collection membership, roles, stable identities and required per-member fields—against the approved platform SPEC without changing chassis state.
original_method: Bind the Chassis collection to the exact BMC/SUT, enumerate every member URI, classify each as enclosure, board, rack, module or approved virtual resource, retrieve complete supported fields and synchronized UI evidence, compare membership and per-member values to the owner SPEC including absent/redundant rules, and verify no power, indicator or thermal control was invoked.
manual_activity: The owner approves the expected member/role/field matrix; an operator confirms UI-only resources and documented platform exceptions and owns the verdict.
required_inputs: Expected chassis member URI and role matrix
Per-member model, serial, asset and health SPEC
Vendor Chassis schema and relationship rules
Absent, redundant, virtual and stale-resource policy
safety_requirements: Do not invoke power, reset, indicator, thermal or configuration actions
Do not treat names as stable identity
Validate endpoint and member-link host identity
Retrieve every member before claiming completeness
Reject duplicate, missing, extra, stale or unclassified resources
Do not clear logs or automatically retry inconsistencies
agent_execution_scope: Verify exact BMC/SUT and collection URI
Capture collection and every member resource
Normalize and compare membership plus all required fields

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The collection GET is a useful discovery start, but .Members[].Name is insufficient and may not even dereference members; `-k` and inline credentials are unsafe and no SPEC comparison is performed.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use protected collection retrieval, dereference every member on the verified host, retain full payloads and compare the approved membership/role/field graph with synchronized UI evidence.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Chassis information and 20/20-minute estimates remain; complete collection/member coverage replaces the names-only shortcut.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Build an expected-versus-observed graph of collection URI, member URI, chassis role, stable identity, contained-by links, associated system and required fields, retaining raw evidence for every node.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Makes all chassis information and collection completeness auditable without changing state.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A member name list cannot prove role, identity, associations, health, model/serial or absence of unexpected resources.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Vendor implementations may expose board and virtual resources with similar names; without role and relationship rules, valid resources can appear duplicate or an unexpected enclosure can be missed.

project_override_considerations: The Project must define which Redfish Chassis members map to the Inventory and LEDs Chassis page and which virtual/redundant members are expected. Processor inventory in the next row is separate coverage.
expected_evidence: Exact BMC/SUT identity, firmware/UI version and approved member/role/field matrix
Complete protected raw Chassis collection and every member payload
Stable identity, role, containment/system association and per-field comparison
Audit/SEL review, exceptions and engineer-owned verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, procedure and criteria consistently require Chassis information versus SPEC. DeepSeek provides incomplete coverage but no alternate Master target.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The member/role matrix, schema and exception rules are normal project inputs; the read-only collection audit is identifiable once supplied.

review_improvement: Replaces display-name enumeration with complete role-aware membership and per-resource validation bound to the exact managed system.
independent_technical_reasoning: A Redfish Chassis collection can legitimately contain multiple resource types with non-unique human names. Stable URIs, chassis roles and containment/system links establish topology; only after that graph is correct can model, serial, asset and health fields be meaningfully compared to SPEC.
